description: This file defines functions for manipulating and transforming effects-related nodes in a Torch FX graph, specifically handling effect tokens in exported Torch programs. It includes utilities to replace effect nodes, remove effect tokens from the graph, and update graph metadata accordingly.

methods.name: _get_custom_obj_for_node(node, inputs_to_lifted_custom_objs, constants)
methods.description: Extracts a custom object from a FX node's arguments, ensuring it is of type CustomObjArgument.

methods.name: _replace_with_effects_node( node, ep, inputs_to_lifted_custom_objs, output_tokens, input_tokens, module )
methods.description: Replaces a with_effects node with its underlying function call, updating the graph accordingly.

methods.name: _replace_invoke_subgraph_node(node, module, output_tokens, input_tokens)
methods.description: Replaces an invoke_subgraph node by removing the token argument, updating subsequent nodes.

methods.name: ExportedProgram _remove_effect_tokens(ep: ExportedProgram)
methods.description: Main function that removes effect tokens from the exported program's graph, updating the graph signature and metadata.

ctags.name: _replace_with_effects_node
ctags.signature: ( node, ep, inputs_to_lifted_custom_objs, output_tokens, input_tokens, module )
